posts.text: kursmål 25 kjøp Pareto: DNO - Impressive production beat.  DNO delivered Q3 production of 143 kbd, 7% ahead of our 134 kbd estimate on a Kurdistan beat - with net ent. also surprising to the upside. North Sea is spot on our expectations, but likely modestly ahead of market expectations with a modest beat to the previously upward revised guidance of 85 kbd (initially 82) as Q1-Q3 has avg. 87 kbd and Q4 is unlikely to show declines. Cons. production of 97 kbd do not represent market expectations. Price realization in the North Sea at USD 99.6/bbl implies a premium of USD ~4/bbl over dated Brent and 9/bbl over ICE Brent. Aker BP and Vår Energi have reported premiums of USD 5-6/bbl with timing of lifting likely being the deviation. Overall, a positive update with solid performance both in the North Sea and in Kurdistan. BUY TP NOK 25
